'''''Multivariate Behavioral Research''''' is a [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] published by [[Taylor & Francis Group]] on behalf of the [[Society of Multivariate Experimental Psychology]]. The [[editor-in-chief]] is [[Peter Molenaar]] ([[Pennsylvania State University]]). Its 2017 [[impact factor]] is 3.691.
